text: Not a source or toolchain regression. History separates into two modes, roughly 9.5-9.8ns before 2026-08-31 and 10.3-10.4ns after, and the same executable produces both locally. ABBA runs therefore mix the modes and show no source correlation, with the nominal bad revision averaging faster on the day. The slow level reproduces; the correlation with the source does not. Cause not identified.
